sentence: This project develops a gene augmentation therapy for Leber congenital amaurosis and tests its safety in rabbit and non-human primate.
This project studies how cells fuse together, a process involved in fertilization, placenta development, bone remodeling, and skeletal muscle development.
This project builds analysis tools that study many kinds of molecular data to find the molecular causes of inflammatory disease at the cellular level.
This project improves a free software library that processes and visualizes medical and biological data so tools run on desktop, cloud, and web.
This project grows airway cells from stem cells to find out how gene changes cause primary ciliary dyskinesia.
This project studies how neurons mature and connect with other neurons to form working circuits in Drosophila.
This project studies how breast cancer cells spread, using 3D imaging of tumors and maps of gene activity.
This project studies how DNA is folded in the cell nucleus and how that folding affects gene expression.
This project builds a sensor array that detects disease fingerprints in patient biofluids and tests it on pancreatic cancer.
This project studies how chromatin features decide where transcription condensates form in the cell nucleus.
This project tests small molecules that block proteins linked to prostate cancer progression, to see how well they work and how safe they are.
This project provides mass spectrometry methods to measure chemical pollutants and trace-elements in environmental samples.
This project studies how a protein that binds RNA affects the intestinal barrier and immune system in necrotizing enterocolitis of premature infants.
This project offers genomic services such as sequencing to cancer researchers and helps them share and analyze genomic data.
This project tries to find microbial metabolites and understand how they act in the host to affect gut inflammation.
This project studies how a stem cell transcription factor drives lineage plasticity in prostate cancer and tests whether blocking it helps.
This project builds peptoid conjugates that block androgen receptor activity and trigger an immune response against drug-resistant prostate cancer cells.
This project studies how cobalamin C deficiency affects human brain development and explores gene editing as a treatment.
This project studies how a scaffolding protein in oligodendrocytes supports myelination and how it changes with aging.
This project holds a conference on ion channels and transporters in immunity, aiming to find drug targets for immune disorders.
